name: Angle Domain Guidance (ADG)
plain: Treats the whole latent as a vector and rotates the conditional by a capped angle, rather than extrapolating. The norm is bounded by construction.
math:
θ = arccos(cos(x̂_u,x̂_c)); θ_w = min((w−1)θ, θ_max)
e = x̂_c − (⟨x̂_u,x̂_c⟩/‖x̂_u‖²)x̂_u
x̂ = cos θ_w·x̂_c + (sin θ_w/sin θ)·e; (w−1)e when sinθ≤1e-3
